mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_board ( parent_board_number, root_board_number, board_type, user_number, title, content, node_type, depth, status ) VALUES ( #{parentBoardNumber}, #{rootBoardNumber}, #{boardType}, #{userNumber}, #{title}, #{content}, #{nodeType}, #{depth}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_number, b.parent_board_number, b.root_board_number, b.board_type, b.user_number, b.title, b.content, b.node_type, b.depth, b.like_count, b.status, b.created_at, b.updated_at, u.login_id, u.name, u.role, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_board c WHERE c.root_board_number = b.board_number AND c.node_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS comment_count FROM tbl_board b INNER JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_number = b.user_number WHERE b.board_type = #{boardType} AND b.node_type = 'POST' AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY b.created_at DESC

SELECT b.board_number, b.parent_board_number, b.root_board_number, b.board_type, b.user_number, b.title, b.content, b.node_type, b.depth, b.like_count, b.status, b.created_at, b.updated_at, u.login_id, u.name, u.role, CASE WHEN b.node_type = 'POST' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_board c WHERE c.root_board_number = b.board_number AND c.node_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ELSE 0 END AS comment_count FROM tbl_board b INNER JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_number = b.user_number WHERE b.board_number = #{boardNumber}

SELECT b.board_number, b.parent_board_number, b.root_board_number, b.board_type, b.user_number, b.title, b.content, b.node_type, b.depth, b.like_count, b.status, b.created_at, b.updated_at, u.login_id, u.name, u.role FROM tbl_board b INNER JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_number = b.user_number WHERE b.root_board_number = #{rootBoardNumber} AND b.node_type = 'COMMENT' AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY b.created_at ASC
